units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 2:4:4">Y. Maasr. II, 50ᵃ</cite> top <he>והשמן משירד לע׳</he> oil (is subject to tithes), when it drips down into the trough; Y. B. Mets. VII, beg. 11ᵇ (insert <he>והשמן</he>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 8:9">Erub. VIII, 9</cite> <he>ע׳ מחזקת וכ׳</he> a pit (in the court for receiving waste water) containing two S’ah.
Ib. 88ᵇ ע׳ מחזיק וכ׳ (masc.). Tosef. ib. IX (VI), 18.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 6:1">Mikv. VI, 1</cite> <he>עוּקַת המערה</he> a pit adjoining a grotto (filled with water); a. v.
